findings.summary: New Era Learning LLC acquired/rebranded cobratate.com to The Real World in December 2022, immediately after Tate brothers' Romanian arrest
findings.detail: Westminster Magistrates Court ruling (CCDC v TTJ, Dec 2024, para 20) states: 'In December 2022 (after the Respondent brothers' arrest), the website was taken down and rebranded to The Real World, owned by to New Era Learning.' The cobratate.com site had previously been operated by Talisman Enterprises SRL (Romania). This establishes NEL as the post-arrest successor entity for the platform.

findings.summary: New Era Learning LLC is NOT registered in Delaware despite using Delaware governing law in its Terms of Service
findings.detail: Live searches of Delaware ICIS return 'No Records Found' for both 'New Era Learning LLC' and 'New Era Learning'. The entity uses Delaware governing law in its Terms of Service and maintains Delaware street addresses, but is not incorporated in Delaware. This is consistent with a structure using nominee DE entities (Thrifty Consulting, Legendary Courses) as fronts while NEL itself is incorporated elsewhere or offshore.

findings.summary: War Room revenue collected through NEL-named UAE Sharjah account; payment processors NMI and Bankcard USA (via Charles Cicack)
findings.detail: Multiple sources report War Room membership payments ($5,454) were directed to an account in the name 'New Era Learning,' registered to a media branch in Sharjah, UAE. Payment processors used included Network Merchants Inc (NMI) and Bankcard USA. Charles Cicack, founder/CEO of High Wire Payments and former Bankcard USA sales agent, is identified as a payment facilitator for the Tate ecosystem.

UK court ruling (CCDC v TTJ, para 20) states cobratate.com was 'taken down and rebranded to The Real World, owned by to New Era Learning' in December 2022. Talisman operated cobratate.com (Hustlers University/War Room) from 2017 with EAT 5%/TT 95% shareholding.

New Era Learning LLC (Delaware) operates The Real World subscription platform at jointherealworld.com. NMI (Network Merchants Inc.) processes all Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Discover card payments for the platform. Confirmed via nmi.therealworld.ag subdomain (dedicated NMI payment relay on Vercel), Kount fraud detection (ssl.kaptcha.com) in checkout, 3D Secure via cdn.3dsintegrator.com, and public acknowledgment in Change.org petition updates.

New Era Learning LLC uses Radom Pay for cryptocurrency subscription payments (USDC and USDT ERC-20). Radom's checkout (pay.radom.com/checkout/{uuid} and formerly pay.radom.network/checkout/{uuid}) is integrated into the TRW checkout flow, appearing alongside NMI card payment options. December 2025 URLScan captured live Radom checkout URL redirecting to Telegram after payment.

The TRW checkout page (checkout.jointherealworld.com) loads ssl.kaptcha.com (Kount by Equifax) for device fingerprinting and fraud detection during card payment processing. Kount is part of the NMI payment stack — NMI resells Kount as a fraud detection service to high-risk merchants.

NMI (Network Merchants Inc.) connects The Real World branded platform and New Era Learning LLC (operator) in its payment gateway role — neither entity has a direct documented edge to the other in the graph, only through NMI and Radom Pay
